messages:
kai: Heads-up — seeing a weird eviction cascade in eu-west1 this morning. small pods get preempted, then we backfill, then larger pods evicted. Preempt margin looks staggered across AZs.
maria: saw that too, noticed spike around 06:12 UTC, backlog +30% in pending queue.
devin: any logs? can you paste `kubectl get pods -o wide` or scheduler logs?
kai: quick snippet from scheduler: 
```
I0320 06:12:05 scheduler.go:423] Preempt eligible: pod=training-job-120 (gpu=1) node=pool-eu-west1-a margin=0.05
I0320 06:12:06 scheduler.go:580] Preempting pod=tex-infer-9 node=pool-eu-west1-b margin=0.2
I0320 06:12:08 descheduler.go:214] Backfill candidate: pod=nlp-batch-3 node=pool-eu-west1-c score=0.88
```
maria: margin on nodes: label `preempt-margin` = 0.05 in a, 0.20 in b and c — who changed that? :thinking: 
jess: fyi opsbot ran AZ-level margin rollout last night for cost canary. script was supposed to keep ordering consistent, but looks like it flipped.
opsbot: @jess rollout `preempt-margin-v2` started at 2026-03-19T23:40Z, paused after 10% due to evictions. reason: `backfill_throughput_drop`.
devin: root cause hypothesis: non-deterministic backfill ordering + margin staircases -> asymmetric preemption waves. lower-margin AZ preempts first, then higher-margin AZs overreact and evict larger pods.
kai: proposal: 1) freeze margins to previous known-good value 2) add 2s descheduler backoff 3) run canary with identical margins across AZs 4) add a metric `preempt-wave-size`.
maria: agree. also throttle immediate backfills — set `--max-backfills=3` on descheduler canary.
jess: i'll rollback the rollout and set `preempt-margin: 0.1` clusterwide for eu-west1. doing staged change with feature flag.
devin: also add grafana panel for `eviction-churn` and alert if >5/min sustained.
kai: ok rolling rollback now, will update in ~5m. tagging SRE for watch @sre-oncall
opsbot: Rollback triggered by @jess at 2026-03-20T06:30Z — status: in-progress.
sre-oncall: watching logs, will post if we see resurface.
jess: follow-up: i'll drop a short runbook link for rollback steps and open a bug to rework rollout ordering (script currently picks AZs by map iteration).
kai: perf note: aligning margins removed cascading evictions in our dev cluster last week — low-risk fix.
maria: action items: 1) confirm rollback complete 2) deploy descheduler backoff canary 3) add dashboard + alert 4) open postmortem if instability >30m.
devin: thanks — ping me for scheduler patch review.
kai: thx all :thumbsup:
